results.rationale: Consistency: white background and some right-column animals remain, but yarn and eggs disappear, milk moves, and numerous cows/chickens/sheep are added across the layout. Instruction: there are no clear product-to-origin matches; the original matching worksheet becomes an unrelated animal collage. Knowledge: the explanation is blank; no requested matching is demonstrated. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: individual cartoons are readable, but repeated overlapping conceptual categories and unstructured extra animals make the worksheet semantically incoherent.

Consistency: landscape, pose, ears and painterly texture persist, but trunk length/curve and tusk shapes change noticeably. Instruction: the conspicuously unnatural bright-red skin remains; adjusting the trunk and tusks does not correct that unreasonable animal attribute. Quality: coherent painted anatomy and landscape, but the uniformly saturated red skin is a clear natural-appearance anomaly.
